items.title: Classify Authority production receipt core dependency
items.context: Use rg and existing tests to identify local core places where Authority receipt refs can set productionDoneEligible or claim production completion.
items.userSees: User sees: "Authority production receipt dependency classified: local core path is authority-receipt-ref productionDoneEligible=true before demotion."

happy.desc: Existing Authority receipt productionDone eligibility is identified in proof-admissibility registry and smoke expectations.

edge.desc: Authority client networking and historical docs are classified as out of scope rather than deleted.

adversarial.desc: The classification does not alter unrelated handoff, usage-ledger, or Red/Repro/Spike semantics.

items.title: Demote production receipt eligibility in local admissibility
items.context: Change local proof-admissibility semantics so Authority receipt refs are evidence/input or external adapter scope, not default productionDone-eligible local proof.
items.userSees: User sees: "authority-receipt-ref production-completion remains allowed as evidence but productionDoneEligible=false."

happy.desc: authority-receipt-ref no longer makes local production-completion productionDoneEligible.

edge.desc: Authority receipt object itself remains diagnostic-status only and is not promoted.

adversarial.desc: DONE-required, local review quorum, offline bundle, handoff, and legacy negative production controls still cannot set productionDone.

items.title: Update CLI proof vocabulary and tests
items.context: Prefer admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, and evidenceScope in local proof results/tests; keep authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone false or legacy/external where still present.
items.userSees: User sees: "Proof vocabulary is CLI-first: evidenceScope and local assurance are primary; productionDone is legacy/external false by default."

happy.desc: Smoke and doc wording describe authority receipt refs as local/external evidence rather than local production completion.

edge.desc: The hardening doc keeps Authority Server conformance as future/external adapter scope, not current local completion.

adversarial.desc: No wording claims server support was deleted everywhere or that local proof equals Authority production completion.

items.title: Verify local CLI-first admissibility boundary
items.context: Run build, proof-admissibility smokes, gap_analyze, convergence_check, and story validation to show local gates do not depend on server production receipt completion.
